pages.text: Swala Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Pweza Asset Managers (SYN). Swala Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to balance income and modest capital growth from fixed income. The management fee of Swala Bond Fund is 1.9 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Swala Bond Fund is SYN Sh 5,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 500. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Swala Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 13.1 percent.

Withdrawals from Swala Bond Fund are paid within 3 business days. The main holdings of Swala Bond Fund are Treasury bonds (45 percent), corporate bonds (30 percent) and bank bonds (25 percent). SYN Trust Company acts as trustee of Swala Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Swala Bond Fund was launched in 2024 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
